weather_report:
Late morning in Subiaco arrives under a rinsed-blue sky, bright and uncomplicated, with the light sharpening every leaf and eave. Forecasts hold it clear through the heart of the day, so expect generous sunshine and a high UV index around midday; the sort of sun that feels gentle at first and then insists on a hat, sunscreen, and good sunglasses. The air reads as clean and transparent, a day with long views and few surprises.

It looks like an easy, pleasant stretch to be out and about. Dress in light, breathable layers you can shed, and carry water if you’re walking between errands. A quiet coffee at a shaded table, a slow wander past shopfronts, or a short ride to pick up a loaf or a library hold would suit the hour. If you’re staying in, open the windows and let the rooms air; the kind of clarity outside makes laundry dry quickly and thoughts tidy themselves.
